name: Evaporated milk (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Evaporated milk [Milk and milk products] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy sources for a microbe growing on this medium are LACTOSE (~10 g/100g, ~292 mM) and CITRIC ACID (~0.3 g/100g, ~16 mM); casein/whey amino acids (glutamate/leucine/proline-rich) are the main N source. Proximates, minerals and vitamins are USDA FoodData Central 'Milk, evaporated, whole' (11211050); amino acids from USDA evaporated-milk records with the remainder scaled from the bovine-milk AA profile to 6.8 g protein; organic acids scaled from fluid-milk citrate/orotate/lactat
curation_added: lactose (the dominant fermentable sugar - was entirely absent; only erroneous sucrose was listed)
citric acid (dominant organic acid ~0.3 g/100g - organic acids were entirely missing)
major fatty acids: palmitic C16:0, oleic C18:1, myristic C14:0, stearic C18:0, butyric C4:0, linoleic C18:2 (only C6/C8/C10/C12 were present)

curation_removed.name: Sucrose C12H22O11
curation_removed.reason: Evaporated milk is UNSWEETENED - it contains no sucrose; its sugar is lactose. FooDB/record mis-assignment. (Sucrose would only belong to SWEETENED condensed milk.) Replaced with lactose.

curation_removed.name: D-Serine
curation_removed.reason: Milk serine is the L-enantiomer; D-Serine is a mapping error. Replaced with L-serine.

curation_removed.name: Nickel
curation_removed.reason: Nickel in milk is a trace contaminant (single-digit ug/L), not a growth nutrient; drop as non-nutritive trace element.

curation_removed.name: CO2 CO2
curation_removed.reason: Dissolved gas / matrix species, not a growth nutrient supplied by the food.

curation_removed.name: O2 O2
curation_removed.reason: Dissolved gas / environmental species, not a food-supplied nutrient.

curation_removed.name: H+
curation_removed.reason: Proton / pH bookkeeping species, not a nutrient.

curation_removed.name: Ammonium
curation_removed.reason: Not a defined nutrient of intact evaporated milk (trace NPN only); non-informative as a supplied component.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
